name: Informed Technologies India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1946, Informed Technologies India Ltd is a part of Khandelwal group of companies and is principally engaged in Business process outsourcing.
keyPoints:
History[1]
Informed Technologies India Ltd is a part of Khandelwal group of companies, established in 1946 with business interests in a wide variety of manufacturing and service industries.
The name of the Company was changed from Khandelwal Ferro Alloys Limited to KFA Corporation Limited and later from KFA Corporation Limited to Informed Technologies India Limited.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.23% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.56% over last 3 years.
